decision_boundary: No policy research may reopen until a studyable validation design is frozen and, later, validated with a fresh holdout.
key_findings: Monthly one-fold evidence remains insufficient on authoritative labeled samples for the dynamic H10-like F4 sequence.
Three-month contiguous accumulation makes the dynamic sequence sample-adequate on available labeled samples, but one 3-month block contains a symbol-subset switch.

Fixed and slow-update membership semantics improve stability by construction and show adequate pre-label density proxies, but lack complete labeled authority for counterfactual membership without replay.
The next lane should not be pure longer-window validation; it needs both membership stability semantics and evidence accumulation.
